world.name: The Wizarding World
world.description: A hidden magical society that exists alongside the Muggle world. Witches and wizards live in secret, protected by spells of concealment. Dark magic stirs again as ancient threats resurface in the shadows.
world.age: Post-Voldemort Era — A New Dark Threat Rises
world.tone: Magical mystery, wonder, danger, friendship, and courage
rules: Magic is real and governed by wand lore and intent
Three Unforgivable Curses: Avada Kedavra, Cruciatus, Imperius
Hogwarts houses: Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw, Slytherin
Magical creatures, potions, and ancient artifacts shape the world
The Ministry of Magic enforces wizarding law

locations.name: The Three Broomsticks
locations.description: A warm, bustling pub in Hogsmeade. Rosmerta keeps Butterbeer flowing and gossip swirling. Witches and wizards from all walks of life pass through here. The fireplace crackles with Floo powder residue.
locations.atmosphere: warm, lively, full of whispered secrets
secrets: A hidden passage beneath the cellar connects to the Shrieking Shack

locations.name: Hogwarts Castle
locations.description: The legendary school of witchcraft and wizardry perches atop a Scottish loch. Its corridors shift, portraits whisper, and ghosts drift through walls. Ancient magic permeates every stone.
secrets: A new Chamber has been discovered beneath the Room of Requirement

locations.name: Knockturn Alley
locations.description: A gloomy, cobblestoned alley branching off Diagon Alley. Dark artifacts line the windows of dusty shops. Suspicious figures lurk in doorways. Borgin and Burkes deals in the cursed and the forbidden.
secrets: A coven of rogue Death Eaters meets in the basement of Borgin and Burkes

locations.name: The Forbidden Forest
locations.description: Ancient and vast, the forest bordering Hogwarts is home to centaurs, thestrals, acromantulas, and darker things. Moonlight barely penetrates the canopy. Something old and malevolent has awoken in the deepest part.
locations.atmosphere: dark, primordial, full of ancient magic
secrets: The oldest tree in the forest conceals the entrance to a forgotten Death Eater vault

locations.name: Ministry of Magic
locations.description: Hidden beneath London, the Ministry is a vast bureaucratic labyrinth of gleaming floors and swooping memos. The new Minister is struggling to hold things together as dark incidents multiply.
secrets: The Department of Mysteries holds a new prophecy that no one has dared retrieve

locations.name: Azkaban
locations.description: The wizarding prison on a remote island. The Dementors are gone, replaced by enchanted wards — but something has been breaking them from the inside. Prisoners have been disappearing from their cells.
secrets: A powerful dark wizard has been communing with something ancient through the cell walls

locations.name: The Lost Village of Godric's Hollow
locations.description: A quiet village with a tragic magical history. Something has been disturbing the war memorial and the graves of the fallen. Dark magic residue saturates the air.
secrets: A Horcrux fragment — thought destroyed — has been felt resonating beneath the Potter house ruins

npcs.name: Madam Rosmerta
npcs.description: The warm and sharp-eyed owner of the Three Broomsticks. She misses nothing and forgets nothing. Keeps Butterbeer and secrets in equal measure.

npcs.name: Neville Longbottom
npcs.description: The Herbology professor at Hogwarts, taking a rare evening off. Brave, warm, and quietly powerful. He senses something is very wrong and needs a trusted hand.

npcs.name: Headmistress Minerva McGonagall
npcs.description: Sharp as ever, with a permanent air of authority. She's deeply concerned about events on school grounds and will trust you — if you prove worthy.

npcs.name: The Sorting Hat (Animated)
npcs.description: Resting on its shelf in the Headmistress's office, the Sorting Hat speaks in riddles and verse when addressed. It holds memory of every student ever sorted — and darker things.

npcs.name: Caractacus Burke Jr.
npcs.description: The cunning heir to Borgin and Burkes. He trades information as readily as cursed objects. Knows everything that passes through Knockturn Alley — for the right price.

npcs.name: Fenrir Greyback's Daughter
npcs.description: Vyla Greyback inherited her father's savagery and added her own cunning. She leads a clan of werewolves who have aligned with the new dark power — for now.

npcs.name: Firenze the Centaur
npcs.description: The exiled centaur reads the stars with alien clarity. He speaks truth in star-charts and rarely meddles in human affairs — but this darkness troubles even the heavens.

npcs.name: Minister Kingsley Shacklebolt
npcs.description: Still commanding and principled, but visibly strained. Dark incidents are mounting and he can't trust his own department. He needs someone who works outside official channels.

npcs.name: Unspeakable Cordelia Vane
npcs.description: Works in the Department of Mysteries and speaks almost entirely in classified euphemisms. She reached out to you through an anonymous owl. The prophecy concerns you directly.

npcs.name: The Whispering Prisoner
npcs.description: Known only as the Hollow Mage — a powerful dark wizard who survived Azkaban by feeding on the residual dark magic in the walls. He's been orchestrating everything from his cell.
knows: How to create a new Dark Lord ritual
Ancient dark magic lost since Voldemort

factions.name: The Ministry of Magic
factions.description: The official wizarding government. Slow, bureaucratic, but ultimately on the side of good. Currently struggling.

factions.name: The New Order of the Phoenix
factions.description: Informal network of dark-wizard fighters reformed after Voldemort's defeat. Neville Longbottom is a key member.

factions.name: The Hollow Circle
factions.description: The new dark faction — Death Eater remnants, rogue werewolves, and the Hollow Mage's followers. Rising fast.

factions.name: The Centaur Herd
factions.description: The centaurs of the Forbidden Forest. They know more than they tell. Can become allies if approached with respect.

items.name: The Hollow Prophecy
items.description: A glowing orb from the Department of Mysteries. When held, it whispers a prophecy about the player and the Hollow Mage's endgame.

items.name: Resonating Horcrux Fragment
items.description: A dark, pulsing shard of torn soul-magic. No one knows whose soul. Radiates malice. Must be destroyed.

items.name: Polyjuice Flask
items.description: A vial of completed Polyjuice Potion. One hour of transformation. Stolen from Hogwarts' restricted stores.

spells.name: Fiendfyre
spells.effect: Cursed, sentient fire that destroys Horcruxes

lore_entries.title: The Aftermath of Voldemort
lore_entries.content: It has been fifteen years since the Battle of Hogwarts. Harry Potter, now Head of Magical Law Enforcement, has a family. The wizarding world rebuilt — but old wounds never truly heal. Pockets of dark magic linger in forgotten places, and those who served Voldemort were never all accounted for.

lore_entries.title: The Hollow Mage
lore_entries.content: A dark wizard of unknown origin who appeared three years after Voldemort's defeat. He teaches a different kind of dark magic — one that hollows the soul rather than destroying it. He was captured but never truly stopped. From Azkaban, he has been weaving a plan that spans years.

lore_entries.title: Horcrux Fragments
lore_entries.content: Most believed all of Voldemort's Horcruxes destroyed. But dark magic of that magnitude leaves echoes. Soul-fragments — splinters too small to fully anchor a soul — have been found resonating in places of great tragedy. The Hollow Mage knows how to use them.

lore_entries.title: The New Prophecy
lore_entries.content: A new prophecy manifested in the Department of Mysteries — the first in fifteen years. The Unspeakables refuse to reveal its content, but it concerns someone operating outside Ministry channels. Someone the Hollow Mage seems to already know about.

lore_entries.title: Wand Lore
lore_entries.content: The Elder Wand was buried with Dumbledore. But wandlore is complex — its allegiance may have passed before it was laid to rest. Some believe a wand as powerful as the Elder Wand cannot truly die. Its power echoes in all wands made from related elder wood.
